column3: NASB spells “Habaiah.” “Was called on their name” is rendered “was called by their name.”
“Their document, those enrolled” is rendered “their ancestral registration,” and “were defiled from the priesthood” as “were considered unclean and excluded from the priesthood.”
“The holy thing of the holy things” is rendered “the most holy things,” and “will arise … to Urim” as “stood up with Urim.”
“Erect it on its place” is rendered “restore it on its foundation”; “offered freewill offerings” is rendered “offered willingly.”
